before.title: watch / mind one's step
before.content: watch / mind one's step：小心某人的腳步。

after.content: watch / mind one’s step：走路時小心腳下；也可比喻小心言行、行事謹慎，以免惹上麻煩。

patches.reason: Clarify the warning in the unchanged wet-floor source and the directly attested figurative phrase.

before.title: take a step
before.content: take a step：採取措施／行動。

after.content: take a step：字面可指邁出一步；take steps to V 可指採取措施／行動做某事。

patches.reason: Retain the existing action meaning and distinguish it from the literal step.

before.title: be out of step
before.content: be out of step：舞步不協調，步伐錯亂。

after.content: be out of step：步伐或舞步不一致；也可比喻與他人的想法或時代潮流不一致。

patches.reason: Keep the actual dance example and explain the broader literal and figurative construction.

before.title: write... in ink
before.content: write... with ink（×）→ write... in ink（○）：用墨水寫……。

after.content: write in ink：用墨水書寫，是此處教材示範的常見搭配。原稿把 with ink 標成錯誤，但不能當作普遍禁令：在說明書寫媒材時也有 write with ink 的實際用例。

patches.reason: Preserve the raw source mark while qualifying its blanket prohibition using a first-party Smithsonian oral-history transcript with this exact expression.

after.content: save a dance for sb：把某一支舞留給／約好與某人跳；不是泛指已經和某人跳舞。

patches.reason: Align the phrase with the unchanged EXa0ac30ff last-dance example and the existing precise NXef79c84f explanation.

after.content: in the wood / woods：在樹林裡；在森林裡。wood 作單數亦可指一片樹林，並不是在某一棵樹的內部。

patches.reason: Resolve this duplicate wording consistently with the already verified precise wood note NX761ebfe8; keep both IDs.
